item.title: CVE-2026-89142 · 6.3 MEDIUM — Out-of-bounds Write in Wi-Fi NPU
item.description: In the Wi-Fi NPU FW, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to an incorrect bounds check. This could lead to local denial of service with user execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
